FILES: arrow/constants.py:41-138
ROOT CAUSE: The `DEHUMANIZE_LOCALES` set in `arrow/constants.py` does not include the new locales (Finnish, Nepali, Estonian, and Zulu) that have been refactored and should now be supported by the `dehumanize` function.
CHANGE: Add `"fi"`, `"fi-fi"`, `"ne"`, `"ne-np"`, `"et"`, `"et-ee"`, `"zu"`, and `"zu-za"` to the `DEHUMANIZE_LOCALES` set in `arrow/constants.py`.
TEST: tests/test_arrow.py

I have updated `arrow/constants.py` to include the new locales (`fi`, `fi-fi`, `ne`, `ne-np`, `et`, `et-ee`, `zu`, and `zu-za`) in the `DEHUMANIZE_LOCALES` set. This enables the `dehumanize` function to support Finnish, Nepali, Estonian, and Zulu.

To verify the changes, you can run the tests in `tests/test_arrow.py`.
